headline: Costco Results Will Be This Earning Season’s Last Look at the Consumer
summary: Costco  Wholesale is the last major retailer to report results this earnings season. For its fiscal third quarter, Costco is expected to earn $4.98 a share, a 16.3% increase from the year-ago period, on a 10% rise in revenue to $69.68 billion.
